import pytest


def shout(xs: list[str]) -> None:
    """Print each string in xs upper-cased, one per line."""
    for s in xs:
        print(s.upper())


def test_shout(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    shout(["hello", "World"])
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "HELLO\nWORLD\n"

    shout([])
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ""

    shout(["a", "", "b c"])
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "A\n\nB C\n"
